headline: Contested Belt Shifts as Weathered Front Erupts
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt still changing, with WeatheredExpanse now the freshest flashpoint. Six strategic-base events were recorded there in the past two hours and 23 across the day; its holdings stand at five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral positions, while casualty rates accelerate on both sides. Gutter remains unsettled, with four new events and 27 during the day; the count is now two Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base, despite cooling casualty traffic. PalantineBerm likewise posted four recent events and 27 across 24 hours, now listing one Warden and six Colonial bases. LinnMercy has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window but retains 15 daily events amid eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral holdings. MarbanHollow recorded no fresh movement in two hours, though 23 events mark it as an active front. Godcrofts has also gone quiet recently after 46 events during the day. Elsewhere, NevishLine shows no new movement in the latest window, while heavy losses continue at CallahansPassage without recorded base events. No victor is declared.
